sentences.en: A. Internationally, 'giftedness' is most frequently determined by a score on a general intelligence test, known as an IQ test, which is above a chosen cut-off point, usually at around the top 2-5%.
sentences.zh: 答：在国际上,“天赋”最常由一般智力测试（称为 IQ 测试）的分数来确定,该分数高于选定的截止点,通常在前 2-5% 左右。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词。

sentences.en: Children's educational environment contributes to the IQ score and the way intelligence is used.
sentences.zh: 儿童的教育环境影响智商得分和智力的使用方式。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: For example, a very close positive relationship was found when children's IQ scores were compared with their home educational provision (Freeman, 2010).
sentences.zh: 例如,当将儿童的智商分数与其家庭教育条件进行比较时,发现了非常密切的正相关关系（Freeman,2010）。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 状语从句
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: The higher the children's IQ scores, especially over IQ 130, the better the quality of their educational backup, measured in terms of reported verbal interactions with parents, number of books and activities in their home etc.
sentences.zh: 孩子的智商分数越高,尤其是智商超过130,他们的教育支持质量就越好,衡量标准是与父母的口头互动、书籍数量和家里的活动等。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Because IQ tests are decidedly influenced by what the child has learned, they are to some extent measures of current achievement based on age-norms; that is, how well the children have learned to manipulate their knowledge and know-how within the terms of the test.
sentences.zh: 因为智商测试明显受到孩子所学内容的影响,所以它们在某种程度上是基于年龄标准的当前成就的衡量标准；也就是说,孩子们在测试范围内学会运用他们的知识和技能的程度。

grammar.type: 状语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: The vocabulary aspect, for example, is dependent on having heard those words.
sentences.zh: 例如,词汇方面取决于听过这些单词。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: But IQ tests can neither identify the processes of learning and thinking nor predict creativity.
sentences.zh: 但是智商测试既不能识别学习和思考的过程,也不能预测创造力。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: B. Excellence does not emerge without appropriate help.
sentences.zh: B. 如果没有适当的帮助,卓越不会出现。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: To reach an exceptionally high standard in any area very able children need the means to learn, which includes material to work with and focused challenging tuition-and the encouragement to follow their dream.
sentences.zh: 为了在任何领域达到极高的标准,非常有能力的孩子需要学习手段,其中包括可使用的材料和具有挑战性的集中教学,以及追随梦想的鼓励。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: There appears to be a qualitative difference in the way the intellectually highly able think, compared with more average-ability or older pupils, for whom external regulation by the teacher often compensates for lack of internal regulation.
sentences.zh: 与能力一般或年龄较大的学生相比,智力高的学生的思维方式似乎存在质的差异,对他们来说,教师的外部监管往往可以弥补内部监管的缺乏。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: To be at their most effective in their self-regulation, all children can be helped to identify their own ways of learning - metacognition - which will include strategies of planning, monitoring, evaluation, and choice of what to learn.
sentences.zh: 为了最有效地进行自我调节,可以帮助所有孩子确定自己的学习方式——元认知——其中包括规划、监控、评估和选择学习内容的策略。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 被动语态
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: Emotional awareness is also part of metacognition, so children should be helped to be aware of their feelings around the area to be learned, feelings of curiosity or confidence, for example.
sentences.zh: 情绪意识也是元认知的一部分,因此应该帮助孩子们意识到他们对要学习的领域的感受,例如好奇心或自信的感觉。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: C. High achievers have been found to use self-regulatory learning strategies more often and more effectively than lower achievers, and are better able to transfer these strategies to deal with unfamiliar tasks.
sentences.zh: C. 研究发现,高成就者比低成就者更频繁、更有效地使用自我调节学习策略,并且能够更好地运用这些策略来处理不熟悉的任务。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: This happens to such a high degree in some children that they appear to be demonstrating talent in particular areas.
sentences.zh: 这种情况在一些孩子身上发生得非常频繁,以至于他们似乎在特定领域表现出了天赋。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Overviewing research on the thinking process of highly able children, (Shore and Kanevsky, 1993) put the instructor's problem succinctly: ‘If they [the gifted] merely think more quickly, then we need only teach more quickly.
sentences.zh: 纵观对高能力儿童思维过程的研究,（Shore 和 Kanevsky,1993）简洁地提出了教师的问题：“如果他们（有天赋的人）只是思考得更快,那么我们只需要教得更快。”

grammar.type: 状语从句 + 分词结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。

sentences.en: If they merely make fewer errors, then we can shorten the practice'.
sentences.zh: 如果他们只是犯更少的错误,那么我们就可以缩短练习时间”。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: But of course, this is not entirely the case; adjustments have to be made in methods of learning and teaching, to take account of the many ways individuals think.
sentences.zh: 但当然,情况并不完全如此；必须对学习和教学方法进行调整,以考虑到个人的多种思维方式。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: D. Yet in order to learn by themselves, the gifted do need some support from their teachers.
sentences.zh: D. 然而,为了自学,有天赋的人确实需要老师的一些支持。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Conversely, teachers who have a tendency to 'overdirect' can diminish their gifted pupils' learning autonomy.
sentences.zh: 相反,有“过度指导”倾向的教师会削弱天才学生的学习自主性。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词。

sentences.en: Although 'spoon-feeding' can produce extremely high examination results, these are not always followed by equally impressive life successes.
sentences.zh: 虽然“填鸭式”可以产生极高的考试成绩,但这些成绩并不总是能带来同样令人印象深刻的人生成功。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: Too much dependence on the teacher risks loss of autonomy and motivation to discover.
sentences.zh: 过度依赖老师可能会导致失去自主性和探索动力。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: However, when teachers help pupils to reflect on their own learning and thinking activities, they increase their pupils' self-regulation.
sentences.zh: 然而,当教师帮助学生反思自己的学习和思考活动时,他们就增强了学生的自我调节能力。

grammar.type: 状语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: For a young child, it may be just the simple question What have you learned today?' which helps them to recognise what they are doing.
sentences.zh: 对于一个小孩子来说,这可能只是一个简单的问题,你今天学到了什么？这有助于他们认识到自己在做什么。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Given that a fundamental goal of education is to transfer the control of learning from teachers to pupils, improving pupils' learning to learn techniques should be a major outcome of the school experience, especially for the highly competent.
sentences.zh: 鉴于教育的基本目标是将学习的控制权从教师转移到学生,提高学生的学习技能应该是学校经验的主要成果,特别是对于高能力的学生。

grammar.type: 分词结构 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: There are quite a number of new methods which can help, such as child-initiated learning, ability-peer tutoring, etc.
sentences.zh: 有不少新方法可以提供帮助,例如幼儿主动学习、能力同伴辅导等。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词。

sentences.en: Such practices have been found to be particularly useful for bright children from deprived areas.
sentences.zh: 人们发现这种做法对于来自贫困地区的聪明孩子特别有用。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: E. But scientific progress is not all theoretical, knowledge is also vital to outstanding performance: individuals who know a great deal about a specific domain will achieve at a higher level than those who do not (Elshout, 1995).
sentences.zh: E. 但科学进步并不全是理论上的,知识对于出色的表现也至关重要：对特定领域了解很多的个人将比那些不了解的人取得更高的水平（Elshout,1995）。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Research with creative scientists by Simonton (1988) brought him to the conclusion that above a certain high level, characteristics such as independence seemed to contribute more to reaching the highest levels of expertise than intellectual skills, due to the great demands of effort and time needed for learning and practice.
sentences.zh: 西蒙顿（Simonton,1988）对创造性科学家的研究得出的结论是,在一定的高水平之上,由于学习和实践需要大量的努力和时间,独立性等特征似乎比智力技能更有助于达到专业知识的最高水平。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Creativity in all forms can be seen as expertise mixed with a high level of motivation (Weisberg, 1993).
sentences.zh: 各种形式的创造力都可以被视为专业知识与高水平动机的结合（Weisberg,1993）。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: F. ​​​​​To sum up, learning is affected by emotions of both the individual and significant others.
sentences.zh: F.​​​​​综上所述,学习受到个人和重要他人情绪的影响。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 分词结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。

sentences.en: Positive emotions facilitate the creative aspects of learning and negative emotions inhibit it.
sentences.zh: 积极情绪促进学习的创造性方面,而消极情绪则抑制它。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Fear, for example, can limit the development of curiosity, which is a strong force in scientific advance, because it motivates problem-solving behaviour.
sentences.zh: 例如,恐惧会限制好奇心的发展,而好奇心是科学进步的强大力量,因为它会激发解决问题的行为。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 状语从句
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: In Boekaerts' (1991) review of emotion in the learning of very high IQ and highly achieving children, she found emotional forces in harness.
sentences.zh: 在 Boekaerts (1991) 对极高智商和高成就儿童学习中的情绪的回顾中,她发现了情绪的力量。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: They were not only curious, but often had a strong desire to control their environment, improve their learning efficiency, and increase their own learning resources.
sentences.zh: 他们不仅有好奇心,而且往往有强烈的愿望去控制自己的环境,提高自己的学习效率,增加自己的学习资源。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。
